findings: The former 2.0 by 4.0 by 1.2 mm deep disc geometry is replaced by a 97-vertex shallow projected tissue patch per eye.
Each patch follows the frontmost owned sclera or cornea surface with a 0.40 mm clearance and a restrained 0.16 mm central mound.
Projection records zero misses and frames 1, 20, 33 and 61 record zero intersections with all audited eye and body layers.
The failed closed-ellipsoid experiment was rejected because it read as a detached red bead.
The selected surface patch has no bead silhouette in front view and only a restrained tissue indication in oblique view.
The isolated caruncle change is visually neutral at normal distance; a continuous wet line is still required for a meaningful realism gain.
